race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
race.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but CAMPENAERTS is proving progressive for Jonathan Portman and is taken to make light of a 6 lb rise for his comfortable Nottingham success and bag a second C&D victory. In-form C&D winner Maharajas Express could emerge as the chief threat with Billy Loughnane in the saddle, although Rye and Sunlit Sea can also play a prominent role. CAMPENAERTS MAHARAJAS EXPRESS RYE
